holder-quote: Pryde Ulta stopped one of the Faces. Seven left. She had barely caught up to them, running a horse to death with her house’s guard. She—like Bethal Walchaís—had begun to intervene the instant they had heard Maviola’s cry.
effect-quote: Magnolia Reinhart’s circle. The [Lady] pointed and squashed an [Assassin] over a thousand feet away.
